newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to sell 25,000/T Dec Vizag naphtha.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to sell 25,000/T Dec Vizag naphtha.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) is offering by tender 25,000 tonnes of low aromatic naphtha from Vizag, east coast India for lifting December 15-17, industry sources said.
The tender closes December 5 and is valid until December 6.
IOC sold its last low aromatic naphtha cargo, lifting from Bombay during December 10-12 at a discount to Japanese spot quotes of around $17.33 a tonne free-on-board Bombay, to Dutch trader Vitol.
